title: Establishing Islamic Adab and Moral Conscience (Ages 4-6)
description: A 14-day tarbiyah journey to establish foundational Islamic akhlaq values (truthfulness, amanah, rahmah, respect) during the preoperational stage (Piaget). Focuses on transforming concepts from theoretical knowledge into heart-based behavioral habits through compassionate parental modeling, Prophetic stories, and daily dialogue. Avoids coercive methods, and relies on the Prophetic principle of gradualism and qudwah (exemplary conduct) as a tool for moral development in this sensitive stage.

primary_reference.info: ابن القيم الجوزية، تحفة المودود بأحكام المولود، فصل في تأديب الأولاد وتهذيب أخلاقهم

review_defects.why: Inconsistent transliteration: 'sidq' and 'ihtiram' are translated, while 'amanah' and 'rahmah' are transliterated. All should be either translated or transliterated for consistency.
